question.problem: Determine if the vector $u$ lies on the plane $Π:r=sb+tc$, $t,s\in R$, where  $b=⟨-1,3,5⟩$, $c=⟨1,-5,-7⟩$, and  $u=⟨1,-8,-10⟩.$ In the affirmative case, find the value of $s\cdot t$ from the decomposition $u=sb+tc.$
question.worked_solution:
By definition, $u\in Π$ if there exist $t$ and $s$ such that

$$
\begin{aligned}sb+tc & =u \\ s[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3 \\ 5\end{aligned}]+t[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -5 \\ -7\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -8 \\ -10\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}-s+t=1 \\ 3s-5t=-8 \\ 5s-7t=-10\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 & 1 \\ 3 & -5 & -8 \\ 5 & -7 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -2 & -5 \\ 5 & -7 & -10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+5{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & -2 & -5\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & 1 & 1 \\ 0 & -2 & -5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}-s+t=1 \\ -2t=-5 \\ 0=0.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation, we get

$$
-2t=-5\,⟹\,t=\frac{5}{2}.
$$

Substituting into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-s+t & =1 \\ -s+\frac{5}{2} & =1 \\ -s & =-\frac{3}{2} \\ s & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since we found a solution $s=\frac{3}{2},\,t=\frac{5}{2},$ we conclude that $u$ does indeed lie on the plane $Π.$ In fact, we have

$$
u=\frac{3}{2}b+\frac{5}{2}c.
$$

Finally, $s\cdot t=\frac{3}{2}\cdot \frac{5}{2}=\frac{15}{4}.$
